morphology.pattern_note: 外来专名，整词记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分。标准书写为 Sparta；所列 IPA 为按马来语读音规则推定的读法。

senses.zh_definition: 斯巴达：古希腊位于伯罗奔尼撒半岛拉科尼亚地区的城邦；亦为当地现代城市的名称。
senses.en_definition: Sparta, an ancient Greek city-state in Laconia in the Peloponnese, also the name of the modern city.
senses.ms_definition: Nama sebuah negara kota Yunani purba di wilayah Lakonia, Peloponnesos, dan juga nama bandar moden di kawasan tersebut.
senses.nuances: 专有名词，须写作 Sparta。输入未提供上下文或 DBP 释义，此处采用其地理专名义；不能据此判定语料中的具体指称。马来语释义为编写释义。status 沿用指定值，不表示已核实 DBP 收录。地名依据：[Getty 地名数据库](https://www.getty.edu/vow/TGNFullDisplay?english=N&find=7012821&nation=&place=&subjectid=7011065)。

dual_scenarios.en: The lecture examines the system of government in the city-state of Sparta in ancient Greece.

etymology.historical_story: Sparta belongs to the geographical vocabulary of ancient Greece rather than to a productive Malay word family. The name also survives for the modern city, established in 1834 near the ancient remains. Its appearance in Malay historical writing therefore preserves a foreign place name; it does not establish a separate Malay adjective meaning strict or austere. [Municipal tourism account](https://realsparta.gr/en-us/discover/highlights/sparta-the-legendary-city).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Sparta 与“斯巴达”直接配对：看到大写 S，先想到地名；不要拆成马来语词缀。
